segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ לוֹקְחִין גַּת בְּעוּטָה מִן הַנׇּכְרִי, אַף עַל פִּי שֶׁהוּא נוֹטֵל בְּיָדוֹ וְנוֹתֵן לַתַּפּוּחַ, וְאֵינוֹ עוֹשֶׂה יֵין נֶסֶךְ עַד שֶׁיֵּרֵד לַבּוֹר. יָרַד לַבּוֹר — מַה שֶּׁבַּבּוֹר אָסוּר, וְהַשְּׁאָר מוּתָּר.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» One «may purchase from a gentile a winepress» in which the grapes have «been trodden» on, «despite» the fact «that» the gentile «takes» grapes «in his hand» from the winepress «and places» them «on the pile» that remains to be trodden on. «And» the gentile’s touch «does not render» the juice of the grapes «wine» used for «a libation» in idol worship, which is forbidden, «until it descends into the» collection «vat,» because until then it does not have the status of wine. Once the wine «descended into the» collection «vat, that which is in the vat» is «prohibited, and the rest,» which did not yet descend into the vat, is «permitted.»

moves.summary: One may buy a trodden winepress from a gentile despite his handling the grapes

moves.cueHe: ואינו עושה יין נסך עד שירד לבור
moves.summary: Libation status begins only when the wine descends to the vat
Once in the vat, what is in the vat is prohibited and the rest permitted

positions.claim: Juice becomes libation wine only once it descends into the vat
